name: Amazon Filter
description: Text-format filter that turns [amazon:ASIN:selector] tags in body text into rendered Amazon product blocks, images and data.
project_description: Amazon Filter is a submodule of Amazon PAAPI5 that provides a single text-format filter (plugin id 'amazon'). Content authors embed Amazon products directly in body text with tokens like [amazon:ASIN:inline], [amazon:ASIN:thumbnail], [amazon:ASIN:button], [amazon:ASIN:title] or grouped [amazon:A|B|C:group]. The filter parses all tokens, batches the ASIN lookups (max 10 per Amazon request) through the parent module's caching pipeline, and replaces each token with the rendered product theme output. It depends on amazon_pa for the lookup/theming layer.
